# Generation 4 — Final Atomic Plan

The Awtsmoos turns many possibilities into one ordered chain;
Awtsmoos.com will not stop at green local code while deployment work remains.

## Atomic execution graph

1. Reconcile the existing 8943 targeted-runtime durable job.
2. Run fresh 120-URL crawler against 8943.
3. Run full/deep sitemap crawl against all discovered URLs with bounded concurrency.
4. Record every runtime defect; repair real source/generator defects only.
5. Rerun focused SEO gate after any repair.
6. Rerun Heichel quality and route coverage after any repair touching shared runtime behavior.
7. Fetch latest origin/main and prove SEO target overlap status.
8. Create a unique clean integration worktree from latest origin/main.
9. Transfer only exact tested SEO source/generated/docs/test paths into the clean worktree.
10. Verify no unrelated file changed in the clean worktree.
11. Regenerate SEO artifacts there and prove idempotence.
12. Run all SEO tests, static audit, XML parse, source law, Heichel quality, and route suite there.
13. Run `npm run test:tunnel-release` in the clean worktree.
14. If manifest omission is reported, run the repository-native manifest rebuild, then rerun release tests.
15. Start a clean-worktree local server and rerun targeted + deep crawl acceptance.
16. Fetch origin/main again; if moved, rebase/recreate integration worktree and retest affected boundaries.
17. Commit exact allowlist only.
18. Push race-safely to main.
19. Guardedly activate the exact pushed SHA in production.
20. Verify production service/checkout state where evidence is available.
21. Raw HTTPS verify every critical public family and XML MIME/parse behavior.
22. Browser-shadow verify public rendered titles/canonicals.
23. Re-read all touched files and compare planned versus actual.
24. Search for hidden tests, docs, edge cases, performance, security, deployment, and maintenance work.
25. Update REMAINING_WORK to empty only if no safe useful work remains.
26. Return the full deployed Awtsmoos.com links to the user.
